name: Mystic Styx
source:
Any person at least once in life thought about what if his or her wish will be fulfilled. 

Ilaya Kaya - her dreams come true as by sorcery. However, is it good or bad? When even the involuntary dream can become a reality. Not by the way you think of it...

Dehi Karonay - a warlock, which offers a deal to Ilaya. She promises to rid the girl of the curse. But she requires something valuable as a fee.

A Dehi's partner, Saiven Silversmith, recently became an alchemist. Quite by accident, Saiven is a longtime friend of Ilaya.

Is it a joke of fate or Ilaya's desire?
